The specific eval name, ideally unique (e.g. GSM8K, mmlu_physics). Primarily for display/filtering when evaluation_result_id is unavailable. If an evaluation run reports multiple aggregate results/metrics for the same sample, emit multiple instance records (one per aggregate result) rather than trying to attach a single instance record to many aggregate results.

Preferred deterministic foreign key to aggregate evaluation_results[].evaluation_result_id.
